name: The Delegation Divide — Agent Delegability Index (ADI)
description: An open index of AI-agent delegability for 433 ISCO-08 occupations and 146 countries (v2026.1). Rates every O*NET 30.2 task statement (18,796) on a frozen, preregistered four-level rubric (L0 no role, L1 augmentation, L2 partial delegation, L3 full delegation) plus four barriers with two language models (Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5), aggregates to ISCO-08 unit groups and weights by ILOSTAT employment into a country atlas. Headline: 35.2% of task time in world employment is at least partly delegable to AI agents in 2026; 2.5% fully. Ships open data (CSV/Parquet), a static JSON API, a Python package (adi-index) and an MCP server (adi-mcp) so AI agents can query and cite the index.
